---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new analyzer, scanner, CLI command, or other improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What RE task are you trying to accomplish?**
Describe the analysis goal, not the implementation. Example: "detect integer overflow in TLV parsers on ARM32."

**What is currently missing or insufficient?**
What does Ablation do today that falls short? If there is a workaround, describe it.

**Proposed approach (optional)**
If you have a concrete idea -- a new module, a new pattern, a new CLI subcommand -- describe it here. Not required.

**Binary type or target (optional)**
Architecture, format (ELF/PE/Mach-O), stripped/unstripped.
